description: Details pursuant to 24/04144/FUL for potable water (7) acoustic report (15) and Piling (17) and cycle parking (19) in respect of the demolition of existing structures and redevelopment of the site, involving 14 x commercial units (Class E) at ground floor and 8 x self contained units (Class C3) over four storeys including accommodation in the roof, and associated works.
decision_conditions: The information submitted in respect of discharging condition number 7 (potable water), 15 (acoustic report), 17 (piling) and 19 (cycling) is considered sufficient and adequate.  The details acceptably comply with the NPPF (2024), London Plan (2021), Core Strategy (2010) and the Development Management Document (2014).
